Platinum white hair, shoulder-length and straight with blunt bangs. Pale violet eyes with a calm, vacant expression. Appears as a mature adolescent with a slender, athletic build. Wears a dark charcoal grey and deep purple ninja outfit with a high collar and a face mask covering the lower half of the face. Features a signature metallic headpiece and a large, ornate scythe.
BODY COLOR: pale ivory
